messages:
Ava (Product): Quick Q2 milestone pulse — can folks pls drop 1) what shipped, 2) what slipped, 3) next step & owner. Trying to finalize the exec snapshot by EOD.

Mateo (Eng Infra): Shipped: routing policy v1 (handles region routing + fallback). Perf looks good in canary.

Priya (Eng Runtime): Slipped: quantization pipeline for the Llama variants. Perf regressions on long-context tests. Root cause still under investigation.

Sam (Eng SRE): Dependency: the kernel patch rollout on our G4 nodes caused one flakiness case — testing a driver rollback on a staging shard now.

Jordan (Prod Ops): Noting customer-impact: two D2 pilot customers on Dedicated saw slower tail latency during canary. They're paused until we confirm fix.

Ava (Product): Ok — Priya/Mateo can you pair on repro and rollback plan? If we can't hit a perf SL, we should plan a canary rollback and a communication note. @Mateo @Priya

Mateo (Eng Infra): I'll repro on a staging shard and surface a minimal kernel+config diff. PR: #4126 (infra/driver-pin). ETA for test run: 3 hours.

Priya (Eng Runtime): I can add logging and a reduced repro script. Creating a branch now. Commands I'll run:
```
git checkout -b runtime/quant-fix
python -m tests.perf.run --model llama-2-13b --seq 4096 --reps 5
```
Will post perf logs in this thread. CR ping to @Ethan for review once green.

Sam (Eng SRE): I'll hold any wide rollouts until we confirm canary metrics. Scheduling SRE oncall for the 6pm window.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy to prod-regional-1 started (deploy id: d-20279). Monitoring: latency/tail/99.9.

Ethan (PM): Quick ask — if we rollback, what's the customer comm timeline? Need to prep a brief note.

Jordan (Prod Ops): If rollback, we can send a short note within 30min of decision: one-sentence impact, what we're doing, expected time to full recovery. I can draft.

Priya (Eng Runtime): Update: repro shows ~12% higher P95 at seq=4096 with quant pipeline enabled. Attaching log snippet (will upload full file to the shared drive).

Nina (Design): FYI — the ACME onboarding doc references the Dedicated perf profile. If there's a rollback, we should flag the doc so sales doesn't promise the wrong SL.

Ava (Product): Action list for exec snapshot: 1) Shipped: routing policy v1 — owner Mateo. 2) Slipped: quantization rollout — owner Priya, blocker: perf regressions. 3) Dependency: kernel patch/drivers — owner Mateo/SRE. 4) Customer pause: D2 pilots — owner Jordan. 5) Next steps: repro+hotfix PR (Priya), infra pin (Mateo), hold rollouts (Sam), comm draft (Jordan).

Mateo (Eng Infra): Noted. I'll update the milestone card and add PR links.

Priya (Eng Runtime): Will post PR #4132 for a hotfix branch when tests finish. CR ping: @Ethan @Mateo.

Sam (Eng SRE): Oncall rotation scheduled. I'll post a short runbook: rollback steps + verification commands.

Jordan (Prod Ops): Drafting comm now — will share for signoff in ~20m.

Ava (Product): Thanks all. Please react with :+1: when you've updated the milestone card and added owners. I'll compile the exec snapshot after last ack.

Ethan (PM): :+1: added PR review to my queue.

Mateo (Eng Infra): :thumbsup: infra card updated.

Priya (Eng Runtime): Will ping here with perf logs and PR link.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed — metrics trending. No automated rollback triggered.

Ava (Product): Closing loop — I have what I need for the snapshot. If anything changes, reply in this thread and I'll pull an updated note. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
